title: 第15章 跪下给我磕头道歉第16章 巨大收获撼山拳昆吾拳
slug: 亿倍返还双手插兜没有对手
lines: 不料项威听了，也猛的笑了起来，沉声道：“你拿什么杀我们？废话少说，吃我一拳！”
他身上气息暴涨，如龙似虎，骨关节爆响，一拳轰来，其势如浪。
他要一拳把苏长歌制服，然后慢慢拷问！
王惊龙哈哈大笑，疯狂叫嚣：“哈哈哈哈，我大哥生气了，你现在后悔也来不及了！”
“我会后悔？笑话！”
面对这一拳，苏长歌眼也不眨一下，深吸一口气，运转太初极道法典。
体内血红色真气也跟着运转起来，各条经脉顿时爆发出大江怒浪般的声音，骨筋膜噼啪作响。
一股恐怖的气势，猛然爆发开来！
地面承受不住这股气势，直接炸裂，冒起滚滚浓烟！
“什么！”
王惊龙震惊。
项威也是脸色一变，心中凛然！
苏长歌没有多讲，面对项威这一拳，同样是一拳迎了上去。
眨眼间，两拳狠狠撞击在一起！
空气中爆出一声炸响，席卷出无穷风浪，猎猎作响，狂风激荡。
王惊龙只听到一声痛苦至极的惨叫，立刻察觉眼前一黑，一个身影狼狈倒飞了出去。
赫然是项威倒飞了出去！
他那魁梧的身子仿佛便成弱不禁风的树苗一般，直接被轰飞，一边飞，一边大口吐血！
王惊龙愣住了。
骇然的脸上全都是难以置信，这是什么情况，大哥竟被苏长歌给一拳打飞了？
他看向项威，只见项威凄惨无比，拳头连带着整条手臂都是炸裂，露出了肩膀阴森森的白骨，鲜血淋漓，好不凄惨！
一拳！
苏长歌仅是一拳，就硬生生打爆了项威整条手臂！
项威脸色豁然大变，惨白无比，面无血色，仿佛经历了全世界最难以置信的事情一般，嘴巴张的巨大，难以置信！
这个苏长歌，怎么会这么强！
“打住！
今日之事就此结束，告辞！”
唰的一声，项威抬脚就走，头也不回。
“你想来就来，想走就走？哪那么容易！”
苏长歌冷哼一声，猛的闪身追去。
他体内轰然炸响，力量尽出，全身擂响，百骸震动，血红色真气将浑身血液搅动的轰隆作响，一拳轰向项威后心！
项威心头大骇，赶忙转身，咬了咬牙，取出一面厚实的铁盾，横在身前抵挡！
“咔嚓！”
“咔嚓嚓！”
铁盾爆发出惊人的炸响，被这一拳生生贯穿，寸寸爆碎，炸成碎片！
项威脸色猛变，赶忙求饶：“不……苏师弟，停手，我今天不该……！”
content_en:
Unexpectedly, Xiang Wei burst out laughing after hearing this, and said in a deep voice: "Why are you killing us? Stop talking nonsense and just punch me!"
"Boom!"
The aura on his body surged, like a dragon or a tiger, his bones and joints crackled, and a punch struck with force like a wave.
He wanted to subdue Su Changge with one punch and then torture him slowly!
Wang Jinglong laughed loudly and yelled crazily: "Hahahaha, my elder brother is angry, it's too late for you to regret it now!"
"Will I regret it? What a joke!"
Facing this punch, Su Changge didn't blink, took a deep breath, and activated the Taichu Ji Dao Code.
The blood-red Qi in the body also started to circulate, and all the meridians suddenly erupted with a sound like the roar of a river, and the bone fascia crackled.
A terrifying momentum suddenly erupted!
"Boom!"
The ground couldn't bear the momentum and exploded, sending up billowing smoke!
"What!"
Wang Jinglong was shocked.
Xiang Wei's expression also changed, and he felt awe-inspiring!
Su Changge didn't say much. Faced with Xiang Wei's punch, he also punched him.
In the blink of an eye, the two fists collided hard!
"Bang!"
There was an explosion in the air, sweeping up endless wind and waves, hunting sounds, and strong winds.
"Ah!"
Wang Jinglong only heard a scream of extreme pain, and immediately noticed that his vision went dark, and a figure flew out in embarrassment.
Shockingly, Xiang Wei flew out!
His burly body seemed to have turned into a weak sapling, and was directly blown away, vomiting blood as he flew!
Wang Jinglong was stunned.
The shocked face was full of disbelief. What happened? The eldest brother was punched away by Su Changge?
He looked at Xiang Wei and saw that Xiang Wei was in extremely miserable condition. His fists and entire arms exploded, revealing the ghastly white bones of his shoulders. They were dripping with blood. It was so miserable!
One punch!
Su Changge broke Xiang Wei's entire arm with just one punch!
Xiang Wei's face suddenly changed. He was extremely pale and bloodless, as if he had experienced the most unbelievable thing in the world. His mouth opened so hugely that it was unbelievable!
How could this Su Changge be so strong!
"Stop it!
That’s the end of today’s business, farewell! "
With a whoosh, Xiang Wei walked away without looking back.
"You can come when you want and leave when you want? It's not that easy!"
Su Changge snorted coldly and dashed away to chase after him.
There was an explosion in his body, and all his strength was unleashed. His whole body was pounding, his bones were shaking, and the blood-red Qi stirred up the blood all over his body. He punched Xiang Wei in the back of his heart!
Xiang Wei was horrified, turned around quickly, gritted his teeth, took out a thick iron shield, and placed it in front of him to resist!
"Crack!"
"Crack!"
The iron shield erupted with an astonishing explosion. It was penetrated by this punch, shattered inch by inch, and exploded into pieces!
Xiang Wei's expression suddenly changed and he quickly begged for mercy: "No... Junior Brother Su, stop, I shouldn't have... today!"
"Boom!"
